title: DealIndirectPartner - Data API
description: Represents an indirect partner’s involvement in a deal. This object is available in API version 63.0 and later.

AccountId.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update
AccountId.description: The account associated with the indirect partner on the deal. This field is a relationship field.

LastReferencedDate.description: The timestamp when the record was last referenced by the user or system.

LastViewedDate.description: Date and the timestamp when the record was last viewed in the Salesforce UI. Helps monitor user access and engagement.

LeadId.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update
LeadId.description: Reference to a lead associated with this indirect partner record. This field is a relationship field.

Name.properties: Autonumber, Defaulted on create, Filter, idLookup, Sort
Name.description: System-generated unique identifier for the record, used for lookup and reference purposes.

OpportunityId.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update
OpportunityId.description: Opportunity associated with the indirect partner. This field is a relationship field.

OwnerId.properties: Create, Defaulted on create, Filter, Group, Sort, Update
OwnerId.description: User or group that owns this record. This field is a polymorphic relationship field.

PartnerName.description: Name of the indirect partner participating in the deal. This field captures the business or entity name.

PartnerRoleType.description: The role played by the indirect partner in the deal. Common values might include Reseller, Distributor, and so on.

PrimaryContactFirstName.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update
PrimaryContactFirstName.description: First name of the primary contact at the partner organization.

PrimaryContactLastName.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update
PrimaryContactLastName.description: Last name of the primary contact at the partner organization.

PrimaryContactName.description: Full name of the primary contact. This field may be auto-generated by combining first and last names or used for reporting purposes.

PrimaryContactSalutation.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update
PrimaryContactSalutation.description: Salutation for the primary contact. Possible values are: Dr. Mr. Mrs. Ms. Mx. Prof.
